name: streampay
description: Workspace-level scripts exposing every workflow step for contributors.

scripts.test:fuzz: echo 'Run fuzz targets manually: cd fuzz && cargo +nightly fuzz run <target>'
scripts.build: npm run build:contract && npm run build:frontend
scripts.errors:check: cargo run -p streampay-contract --example error_surface_doc && git diff --exit-code docs/ERRORS.md
scripts.matrix: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:contract && npm run build:frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run audit && npm run errors:check
scripts.ci:contract: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:contract && npm run errors:check
scripts.ci:frontend: npm run build:frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run audit
